thesis: Unpriced axis values (count, demo, interest_niche, clicks) are unknown, not neutral - sweep them before refining angles
Matched-cell pair: outcome+demo beats outcome-plain on per-dollar signups - favor demo-variant production
Auto-mode cells bought zero trusted measurements two batches running - cut auto, fixed-only readable portfolio
Interest-audience sales cells beat broad sales per dollar at both layers - lean sales budget ~70% to interest
Post-demo, angle family is a wash - three demo batches, three different winners, three purchase angles; rotate evenly
45 signups -> 3 purchases: the bottleneck is post-click - judge cells on per-dollar demos+purchases, signups tiebreak only
Niche sales is the best per-dollar goal-proxy cell (~1 demo/$39, 1 of 3 buys) - give it about half the sales budget
Outcome won the core niche matched cell on goal-proxy per-dollar two batches running - outcome earns favored status
